summary: Performed a read-only adversarial review of development-memory growth, append-only integrity, record granularity, cold/hot rotation, sharding, indexing, and gate scalability.
steps: Inspected the development-memory rules, records, validator, gate tests, hook, CI workflow, package wiring, and repository state without modifying files.
Evaluated archive growth, full-scan costs, immutable-record enforcement, per-record bounds, changed-path duplication, append contention, cold/hot separation, sharding, and indexing tradeoffs.

Recommended retaining the minimal file-backed design at current scale, enforcing record-size and append-only bounds first, and introducing measured shard rotation only after explicit size, latency, or conflict thresholds; rejected premature database, committed derived-index, Bloom-filter, and compaction machinery.

evidence.note: Completed an independent read-only adversarial review and delivered evidence-backed scalability and simplification recommendations to the coordinator.
node --test tests/development-memory-gate.test.ts passed 4 tests; node scripts/check-development-memory.mjs --all reported PASS for the inspected archive.

limitations: The inspected archive was still very small, so shard thresholds remain design recommendations rather than measurements from production-scale history.
The review made no file changes and did not claim implementation or integration ownership.

summary: Fixed the append-only development-memory gate so a legitimate JSONL append after an unterminated final record is not mistaken for rewriting history, while real edits, deletions, reorders, and duplicate records remain visible to validation.

pointers: accepts an append after an unterminated final record without treating it as rewritten
still rejects changing an unterminated final record
keeps a truly duplicated record visible after terminal-newline normalization

steps: Reproduced the blocker on the staged Issue #1 successor: Git represented appending after a no-LF final JSONL record as removal and byte-identical re-addition of the old record followed by the new record, and the existing raw minus-line scan rejected it.

Added one internal diff analysis pass that recognizes only the exact no-LF EOF append sequence, excludes the synthetic historical re-add from effective additions, and leaves every other removed line blocking.
Added focused positive and adversarial tests covering the exact append, changed/deleted/reordered historical records, and a true duplicate that must remain visible to duplicate-ID validation.
Ran focused gate tests, repository typecheck, production build, and the complete offline test suite against the final analyzer and adversarial-test set before freezing this record.

evidence.note: 9/9 gate tests passed after the final analyzer refactor.
Production build completed; lib remains gitignored.
39 tests: 37 passed, 2 RLM_LIVE_SMOKE-gated tests skipped, 0 failed after the final analyzer and adversarial-test refactor.

limitations: The exemption is intentionally limited to an old EOF record with an explicit no-newline marker, a byte-identical immediate re-add, and a following nonempty added record; it is not a general removed/added multiset cancellation.
The fix has not yet been exercised against the paused Issue #1 staged change or independently reviewed; those gates remain required before the successor can commit.
